title: Trusted Shops Category Shops Scraper
description: Browse Trusted Shops stores by category with shop names, ratings, review counts, certification status, and profile links. Batch categories and choose a country market.

batch.title: Category paths
batch.description: Trusted Shops category URL paths such as buch, bekleidung, or sport.
batch.valueDescription: Trusted Shops category path used for this shop search.

schema.description: Category URL path (e.g. bekleidung). Use the Categories endpoint to get available values.
Market code filter (DEU, GBR, AUT, CHE, NLD, ESP, ITA, FRA, BEL, POL, PRT). Default: DEU

shops.shopDescription: Compact design with dependable performance and a two-year warranty.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Browse Trusted Shops stores by category with names, ratings, review counts, certification, and profile links. Batch categories and select a country market.
storeCopy.intro: Find Trusted Shops merchants by category and market. Export shop names, descriptions, ratings, review counts, certification status, and public shop profile links.
useCases: Ecommerce researchers can compare stores and review totals by category.
Marketplace teams can find certified shops in selected country markets.
Brands can map competitor stores and shop profile links.
howToUse: Add a Trusted Shops category path to `categories` for each search.
Choose a country market and set the starting page.
Set `maxPages` and `maxResults`, then export the shop records.

faqs.question: Where do I find a category path?
faqs.answer: Use the category URL path shown by Trusted Shops. The API category listing can provide the available paths.
